svg.title: Component · PicPlace status · preview-only · narrow
svg.desc: Mirrors PicPlaceStatusCard(style: .narrow) for a project this Mac holds only as a preview — its records and poster are here, its originals on PicPlace (App/PicPlace/PicPlaceViews.swift; the phone's state is picplace-status.preview-only.phone.svg). Added 2026-11-06, when the inspector's PICPLACE group came into view at the top of the Gallery item view's preview mirrors (the group moved above the rows on 2026-09-27). DRAWN FROM THE CODE AND THE PHONE STATE, not from a capture: the narrow set's own layout (the status glyph in a 24 pt column, the title 12 pt semibold, the detail 11 pt secondary, the action 11 pt medium in LL.accent trailing on the title's line) with the preview's words — Preview only · The originals are on PicPlace · N files · size · Download originals. The glyph is the grey camera (originals on PicPlace, not here — status glyphs §16). The sample is macOS/gallery.item.preview's shoot: 214 files · 1,16 GB. A capture on a bound bench root is owed (needs account tokens). See components/README.md.

g.text: The originals are on PicPlace · 214 files · 1,16 GB
